row.notes: Allocates a new shared vector of 4-byte values (allocator 0x1460c6c88, control block vtable 0x1456624c0) into result+8/+0x10. Looks at the reader's current value on its stack (reader+0x10): if it is an array (type tag 4) resizes the vector to the element count, then for each element pushes the child value (Ne_RingDeque_PushBack_F1os), calls reader vfunc +0x40 to read it into the 4-byte slot and pops. Generic helper reused by many F1os result handlers.
